confirmed.production: Initially 2 physically separate UE production PCs; scalable to N identical nodes; one concurrent UE and assembly job per node
confirmed.generation: 1 physically separate generation PC; also hosts the shared asset disk
confirmed.asset_storage: Dedicated data folder on the generation PC disk, shared over field LAN SMB; no additional storage PC or NAS
confirmed.operations_ui: PySide6 + Qt Widgets desktop application on operator PC
confirmed.operations_connection: Operator PC application connects to central FastAPI on SSAFY AWS EC2
confirmed.operations_ui_license: LGPLv3 for eligible PySide6 / Qt Widgets components; proprietary application source retained
confirmed.project_phase: Company-requested prototype; future commercial distribution is a separate stage
confirmed.local_database_policy: No SQLite in the initial implementation. Consider it later only when local draft or cache requirements justify it; PostgreSQL remains authoritative.

assembly: Data-driven scene.json with shared prebuilt runtime and catalog; existing compatible skeletal .pak pathway only as optional exception
pending: asset storage path / accounts / permissions / capacity / bandwidth / retention / backup validation
PySide6 / Qt versions, packaging, corresponding source and notices, compatible library replacement verification
operations_lifecycle: Closing the operations UI does not stop central services, Node Agents or Show Agent.

deployment_topology_decision.source: Explicit user decision: 생성 PC 1대·UE 제작 PC 2대·시연 PC 1대; 공유 저장소는 생성 PC의 디스크; UE 제작 N대 확장 유지
deployment_topology_decision.storage_method: SMB shared dedicated data folder on the generation PC disk
deployment_topology_decision.production_scaling: N identical production nodes using one common assembly work queue
deployment_topology_decision.scaled_field_pc_count: N + 2, keeping one generation PC and one show PC
deployment_topology_decision.central_location: SSAFY AWS EC2; temporary laptop before EC2 migration

database_decision.source: Explicit user decision: PostgreSQL로 진행하고 SQLite는 필요할 때 추가
database_decision.sqlite_future_scope: Optional local drafts, query caches or local operational records after a demonstrated need; not a second authoritative database

license_decision.scope: PySide6 + Qt Widgets use under LGPLv3; not a license change for the entire application

edit_mode_decision.source: Explicit user decision (S15P31A504-165): 전체 칸을 편집할 수 있게 한다
edit_mode_decision.scope: Edit production lets the operator change every non-blocked field of the artwork spec (contracts.spec), not only the 7 plan fields

document_status: Agreed target architecture; not an implemented or performance-validated system
